queries.Overall experimental framework: We will: potted European beech climate manipulation experiments with controlled cooling treatments, early leafing induction, pre- and post-solstice daytime and nighttime temperature regimes, and bud set phenology monitoring
queries.Experiment 1 developmental timing manipu: Spring climate chamber cooling to 2-7°C with simulated day-night cycles for potted European beech saplings to delay leaf-out and create late-leafing versus early-leafing trees, then ambient conditions and summer cooling to assess autumn bud set and growth cessation.
queries.Experiment 1 late-season temperature man: Experimental late-season cooling of potted European beech saplings after the summer solstice, with July and August moderate and extreme day-night temperature treatments in climate chambers, comparing early-leafing and late-leafing trees to ambient controls to assess bud set, growth cessation, and autumn phenology under changing photoperiod.
queries.Experiment 2 day/night temperature manip: European beech saplings subjected to pre- and post-solstice daytime, nighttime, and continuous cooling treatments in climate chambers, with bud set and leaf CO2 assimilation measured to evaluate temperature effects on autumn phenology.
queries.Primary phenological endpoint and measur: Measuring autumn bud set in European beech saplings by tracking terminal bud length on primary shoots and lateral stems with digital calipers, defining bud set as the date each bud reaches 90% of maximum length through linear interpolation, to assess primary growth cessation under temperature treatments around the summer solstice.
queries.Statistical analysis: We will use linear: linear mixed-effects models analyzing bud set timing in European beech autumn phenology experiments, with temperature treatment as fixed effect, bud type as random effect, and effect sizes relative to control treatments
queries.Experiment 2 phenological monitoring: We: weekly bud set monitoring of potted European beech saplings using digital caliper measurements to determine primary growth cessation and autumn phenology under pre- and post-solstice daytime and nighttime cooling treatments
queries.Developmental timing measurement: We wil: Monitoring individual leaf-out dates in potted European beech saplings by recording the date when more than fifty percent of leaves are unfolded to assess developmental timing in phenology experiments
queries.Physiological response measurement: We w: measuring leaf-level CO2 assimilation rates in potted European beech saplings exposed to controlled daytime and nighttime cooling treatments to evaluate photosynthetic responses to temperature before and after the summer solstice
queries.Experiment 1 population and randomizatio: potted European beech saplings randomly assigned to treatment groups with standardized soil for climate chamber cooling and autumn bud set phenology
queries.Experiment 2 population and treatment st: Climate chamber experiments with potted European beech Fagus sylvatica saplings testing pre- and post-solstice daytime versus nighttime cooling treatments on autumn bud set, phenology, and photosynthesis under controlled photoperiod and light intensity.
queries.Experiment 1 ambient block phase: From M: European beech saplings maintained under ambient conditions in randomized blocks during late spring before summer temperature treatments, with monitoring of leaf-out and bud set phenology
queries.Experiment 2 post-treatment ambient phas: Fagus sylvatica saplings after pre- and post-solstice daytime versus nighttime cooling treatments, returned to randomized ambient blocks for autumn bud set and phenology monitoring
queries.Moisture control: Both experiments will: Maintaining consistent watering and adequate soil moisture in potted European beech saplings during climate chamber temperature treatments for autumn bud set phenology experiments
